from functools import wraps
from collections import defaultdict

class RateLimiterMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, max_requests, window_seconds):
        self.max_requests = max_requests
        self.window_seconds = window_seconds
        self.request_counts = defaultdict(lambda: {'requests': 0, 'last_reset': 0})

    def __call__(self, func):
        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(request):
            ip = self._get_client_ip(request)
            now = time.time()

            if now - self.request_counts[ip]['last_reset'] > self.window_seconds:
                self.request_counts[ip] = {'requests': 0, 'last_reset': now}

            self.request_counts[ip]['requests'] += 1

            if self.request_counts[ip]['requests'] > self.max_requests:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="Rate limit exceeded.")

            return func(request)

        return wrapper

    def _get_client_ip(self, request):
        return request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr)
```
